item.title: Joules appoints former Asos exec as buying and sourcing director
item.description: Fashion brand Joules has named former Asos exec Katie Coates as its new director of buying and sourcing, Drapers reported. Coates previously served as Asos interim director of responsible sourcing and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) from September 2023 to April 2025, after joining the company in January 2021 as its head of sourcing. item.title: Frasers Group to snap up majority shareholding in Maxi Sport
item.description: Frasers Group is set to acquire a majority shareholding in Italian sportswear retailer Maxi Sport SpA.

item.title: WHSmith launches new sites at Manchester and Liverpool airports
item.description: WHSmith has opened three new sites across Manchester Airport and Liverpool John Lennon Airport this week, marking its continued investment in travel hubs across the North of the UK.

item.title: Quiz Clothing collapses into administration as online store closes
item.description: Quiz Clothing has entered administration, with its online store closing and more than 100 redundancies confirmed following a tough Christmas trading period.

item.title: Lidl unveils seventh pay rise since 2023
item.description: Lidl GB has unveiled a further £29m investment in staff pay, which it claimed would “once again” make it the highest paying UK supermarket.

item.title: Facial recognition: Sainsbury’s removes innocent shopper misidentified as offender
item.description: Sainsbury’s has apologised to a shopper after they were ejected from a store due to a mix-up with workers and the shop’s facial recognition system.

item.title: British shoppers ‘most sceptical’ of marketing communications, according to Intuit report
item.description: British consumers are most likely to opt in to email communications, according to a new report from Intuit, the company behind Mailchimp and QuickBooks. item.title: John Lewis partners with Benugo to revamp in-store restaurants
item.description: John Lewis has teamed up with catering company Benugo to revamp 32 of the retailer’s in-store restaurants.

item.title: Freemans celebrates sixth consecutive year of Christmas growth
item.description: Freemans has reported its sixth consecutive year of growth over Christmas.
